FEBio vs Abaqus biomechanics soft tissue open source
data_payload.evidence_summary: FEBio is an open-source finite element solver specifically tailored for biomechanical applications. It is highly preferred over general-purpose solvers like Abaqus and Ansys because it natively handles complex biphasic, multiphasic, and poroelastic materials, which are essential for modeling hydrated soft tissues (e.g., cartilage, ligaments). As an open-source tool, FEBio offers complete transparency, facilitating rigorous verification and validation, while allowing researchers to easily extend its capabilities through custom plugins for new constitutive models without licensing constraints.
